g.text: 4,096 B table frame ÷ 8 B/PTE = 512 entries (2^9 → 9-bit index per level); 4,096 B page = 2^12 → 12-bit offset

svg.text: Every active bit of 0x0000_7FFF_ABCD_EF01 is drawn in its own cell: the 12-bit offset aligns
cleanly with the last three hex digits (F01), while 9-bit indices straddle 4-bit hex nibbles.
Bits 63:48 must copy bit 47 (0x0000 for user space, 0xFFFF for kernel space); any
non-canonical pointer triggers a General Protection Fault (#GP) before a page walk.
